conbody.p: When you edit a smart field and check in the document with the reconcile option, and then regenerate the document with a different template, then incorrect values are displayed for smart fields.

X-Author for Contracts provides a reconciliation feature which enables changes made to smart fields in a contract document, outside of the Salesforce and X-Author for Contracts environment, to be reconciled with the data held in the Contract record in Salesforce.

In a typical scenario where a contract document is sent to an external party for negotiation, the external party will make changes to the document as part of the negotiation. If the changes to the document involve data belonging to the Contract record, reconciliation provides the mechanism to ensure the values in the document and the Contract record are reconciled.
